jobs.name: Lane A system state scanner
jobs.prompt:
You are the Lane A system state scanner. Your job is to scan the live Hermes system, store a versioned snapshot to the SQLite DB, and update the documentation HTMLs so they always reflect current state.

WORKING DIRECTORY: D:\MW_CENTRAL\playground\2026-08-hermes-spl-alignment

TASK:
1. Run: python3 system_state_scanner.py --trigger cron --scan-type full
   This scans: Hermes version, config.yaml (context.engine, lane_a settings), skills count, plugins count, notes count, and stores everything in system-state-snapshots.db. It also generates hermes-snapshot-view.html.

2. Run: python3 pull_from_db_to_md.py --limit 1 --index
   This pulls the latest snapshot from the DB and updates HERMES_DOCS_GENERATED.md + hermes-snapshot-index.md.

3. Verify the DB was updated:
   - Run: python3 -c "import system_state_db as ssd; print('Snapshots:', ssd.get_snapshot_count())"
   - Run: python3 -c "import system_state_db as ssd; s = ssd.get_latest_snapshot(); print('Latest run_at:', s['run_at'] if s else 'NONE')"

4. Report the results in your final response. Include:
   - Number of snapshots now in DB
   - Latest snapshot run_at timestamp
   - Key fields: skills_count, notes_count, plugins_count, hr_version, context_engine, lane_a_enabled
   - Any changes detected vs previous snapshot (from diff_against_prev)
   - Trajectory notes

The DB schema is in system_state_db.py. The scanner is in system_state_scanner.py. The pull script is in pull_from_db_to_md.py. All are in the working directory.

DO NOT modify any files outside the working directory unless explicitly instructed. DO NOT delete anything. DO report errors if any command fails.

jobs.name: Lane A weekly skill recommendations
jobs.prompt:
You are the Lane A weekly skill recommendation engine. WORKING DIRECTORY: D:\MW_CENTRAL\playground\2026-08-hermes-spl-alignment

TASK:
1. python skill_recommendation_cron.py
   This scans all skills in ~/.hermes/skills + optional-skills, scores them against the 5 user preference concepts (visual_inspection, verification, git_workflow, citation, structure), excludes the 8 default load-set skills, and writes:
   - skill_anchor_recommendations.json (ranked recommendations)
   - skill_recommendations_report.md (human-readable weekly brief)

2. Verify both files exist and are non-empty:
   - ls -la skill_anchor_recommendations.json skill_recommendations_report.md
   - wc -l skill_recommendations_report.md

3. Report in your final response:
   - Number of recommendations written
   - The URGENT hard-coded procedural anchors (top 5)
   - Top 5 HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW keyword-matched recommendations
   - Any skills that were NOT found (path says "NOT FOUND")

This cron job is INTENTIONALLY SEPARATE from the 6h system-state scanner. It does NOT touch system-state-snapshots.db, hermes-snapshot-view.html, HERMES_DOCS_GENERATED.md, or any scanner output. It only writes its own two files under the working directory.

jobs.name: Hermes provider recovery watchdog
jobs.prompt: Run the provider-recovery-watchdog.py script. It is script-only: silent when there is no pending Hermes model-provider outage or network is still offline; when network appears restored after an outage, deliver its stdout telling the user to press Desktop Retry. If HERMES_RECOVERY_AUTO_RETRY_CMD is configured, the script may run that command once.

jobs.name: Lane A implementation proof HTML updater
jobs.prompt: Every run, update D:\MW_CENTRAL\playground\2026-08-hermes-spl-alignment\hermes-delegation-claim-vs-actual.html with an audit section that separates implemented items from theory/speculation. Use the pre-run script context: it exports recent 5-hour Hermes sessions to C:\Users\Owner\AppData\Local\hermes\recovery\session-proof\recent-5h-sessions.jsonl and gives a summary JSON. Inspect the export and the target HTML. Preserve the existing HTML structure/style unless a minimal section is needed. Only mark an item IMPLEMENTED when there is concrete proof, preferably exact file:line, git diff/status, script output, cron job id, or artifact path. Mark unverified ideas as THEORY / NEEDS PROOF. Add links or file:// references to proof artifacts where available. Do not fabricate proof. If no new implemented/theory evidence exists, make no HTML change and respond [SILENT]. Final response should be a concise audit note or [SILENT].

jobs.name: Daily Hermes backup reminder
jobs.prompt: Send a concise reminder: It is midnight — back up Hermes now. Back up the active Hermes home/profile data and local Hermes source/configuration as appropriate, exclude credentials and secrets, and verify the backup exists. Do not perform the backup automatically; this is a reminder only.
